ess.ESS-1: ESS-1 consists of 48 AC-NMC-66P (NMC) cells sourced from donor packs A (20 cells), B (8 cells), and C (20 cells). It was configured using a capacity band rule of ±2%, a resistance band rule of ±10%, and a size of 48 cells per ESS. Based on signed cell test results from 2026-10-29, the battery has a usable capacity of 57.11 Ah (nominal capacity 66 Ah), an average cell capacity of 57.72 Ah, an average cell resistance of 0.85 mΩ, and an SOH of 86.5%. The SOH percentage follows the weakest cell because the cells are connected in series.
